messages:
leo: Quick thread to finalize landing copy variants for the three deployment modes ahead of the launch push and webinar sign-ups. Need: distinct lead messages, one benchmark teaser per page, and form fields to qualify inbound.
maya: Draft idea for top-level hero: 'Consistent LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private environments.' Then mode tiles with 2-line explainer + single CTA (Get demo / Try free). Keep tone actionable.
frank: For the micro-benchmarks I suggest short, honest blurbs: e.g., 'Typical cost reduction: 30-60% vs baseline, depending on model and quantization' and a link to "Benchmark methodology" in a modal. Don't lock numbers in hero copy.
zoe: Sales input: include an inline micro-FAQ on Dedicated/Private pages: "Can we get a custom SLA?" -> "Yes, from X% availability with reserved pools." And a short bullets list of what triggers an AE follow-up (large traffic, compliance ask, on-prem).
rachel: On gating: public page shows one-line summary + a short chart image. Deep-dive (gated) PDF + webinar covers raw numbers, test harness, and model/config used. Registration form should include a checkbox: "Send me the benchmark repo + methodology" to surface technical leads.
oscar: Dev note: form needs hidden fields for utm_campaign and ad_variant. We'll forward signups to our CRM via webhook and tag lead_score=benchmark_interest if checkbox ticked. Example querystring we expect: 
```
?utm_source=ads&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&ad_variant=benchmark
```
leo: For the launch post copy, let's craft two headline directions for A/B: 1) Benefit-first: 'Lower inference cost, keep responsiveness' 2) Trust-first: 'Inference you can run anywhere, with enterprise controls.' Use different ad creative to match.
maya: I'll produce three hero headlines and 2 short subheads per mode. Frank, can you review the benchmark blurbs to make sure we don't overclaim?
frank: Yep. I'll add an explicit qualifier: 'Measured on: model-Y (open), 1k-2k context, FP16/4-bit quantized; results vary by sequence length and model.' Keep this in the gated section.
zoe: For landing CTAs, prefer 'Request demo' on Dedicated/Private and 'Start free trial' on Hosted. That helps route leads in the form handler. We'll also add a small copy snippet near the form: 'Typical set-ups we help scale: customer-facing chat, summarization pipelines, search re-rankers.'
rachel: Webinar funnel: run two targeting buckets: Benchmark-curious (ad variant A) and Reliability-curious (ad variant B). Each variant lands on the same page but scrolls to different anchor blocks and sets ad_variant hidden value.
oscar: I'll spin up the dev story for forms + webhooks and include sample payload fields. Tagging infra: #marketing-forms.
leo: Timeline: we want page live Tues, launch post Wed, webinar promo runs Thu. Who's blocking?
maya: I'll need review time from Frank and Zoe by EOD today.
frank: I can review benchmark copy by 4pm.
zoe: I'll send sales snippets and qualifying questions by 5pm.
leo: Great — if no blockers, we'll proceed. Drop anything urgent here. :rocket:
